items.title: MIT engineers developed a dry, stretchy material that can be used in ultrasound scans

items.description: A team of engineers at MIT has unveiled a revolutionary dry and elastic material that efficiently transmits ultrasound waves for health monitoring wearables. items.description: Ohio's appellate court has ordered Willard H. Sturt to pay his ex-wife Diane F. Sturt over $101,000 due to his neglect of home expenses mandated in their divorce settlement.
